title: The Movers and Shakers of Naya

entities.name: Naya
entities.description: Shard of Alara overrun by lush tropical jungle, home to humans, elves, Nacatl leonin and gargantuan behemoths; Alara's cradle of life.

entities.name: Alara
entities.description: Plane that was broken into five shards by the Sundering.

entities.name: Grixis
entities.description: Shard of Alara where humanity is threatened with extinction.

entities.name: Esper
entities.description: Shard of Alara of etherium, sphinx Hegemons and a grid-divided night sky.

entities.name: Whitecover
entities.description: Permanent pale mist that hangs over Naya's rainforest.

entities.name: Sundering of Alara
entities.description: The breaking of Alara into its five shards, which Cylia is believed to have witnessed.

entities.name: Cylian elves
entities.description: Naya's elves, the spiritual center of the plane, who worship gargantuans as gods and are overseen by the Anima.

entities.name: Cylia
entities.description: First elvish high priest, believed to have witnessed the breaking of the world.

entities.name: Mayael
entities.description: Current Anima of the Cylian elves, who reads signs of the forest as prophecy and believes Progenitus slumbers below Naya.

entities.name: Progenitus
entities.description: Ancient hydra god believed to slumber below Naya and send omen-laden visions to the elves.

entities.name: Nacatl
entities.description: Ferocious leonin jungle warriors of Naya living in prides, once one empire guided by the Coil.

entities.name: Wild Nacatl
entities.description: Prides who followed Marisi, broke free of the Coil and returned to the jungle.

entities.name: Cloud Nacatl
entities.description: Nacatl who kept to the structured civilization of the Coil in the mountains.

entities.name: Marisi
entities.description: Revolutionary Nacatl who led the revolt against the Coil; believed long dead.

entities.name: The Coil
entities.description: Set of laws and strictures that governed the Nacatl civilization, inscribed in a great wall of white stone.

entities.name: Breaking of the Coil
entities.description: Civil war in which the white wall housing the Coil was broken and the Nacatl split in two.

entities.name: Ajani Goldmane
entities.description: Planeswalker native to Naya, part of a Wild Nacatl pride.

entities.name: Jazal Goldmane
entities.description: Ajani Goldmane's brother, murdered during a Festival of Marisi.

entities.name: Gargantuans
entities.description: Huge beasts of Naya, worshipped as gods by the elves and embodiments of Naya's natural laws.

entities.name: Exuberants
entities.description: Naya humans who celebrate life in all its forms and dwell in ziggurats and jungle cities.

entities.name: Drumhunters
entities.description: Naya humans who hunt in packs and use jungle roots to communicate.

events.summary: The elves of Naya trace their name to Cylia, the first high priest, who witnessed the breaking of the world, and are led by a succession of Anima.
events.quote: They call themselves the Cylian elves after the beautiful Cylia, the first elvish high priest

events.summary: Marisi calls the Nacatl to revolt against the Coil; a civil war breaks the white wall and splits the race into Wild and Cloud Nacatl.
events.quote: A revolutionary Nacatl named Marisi called upon his fellow leonin to revolt against the strictures of the Coil, and a great civil war broke out.

events.summary: During a Festival of Marisi, Ajani Goldmane's brother Jazal is murdered.
events.quote: It was during a Festival of Marisi that Ajani Goldmane's brother, Jazal, was murdered.

relations.note: Current Anima, the spiritual and prophetic heart of elf society.
relations.quote: Mayael, the elves' current Anima, reads the signs of the forest as prophecy

relations.note: She believes Progenitus slumbers below Naya and sends visions to her people.
relations.quote: believing that the ancient hydra god Progenitus slumbers below Naya
Ajani Goldmane's brother, Jazal, was murdered.

relations.note: Part of a Wild Nacatl pride.
relations.quote: is part of a Wild Nacatl pride

relations.note: The elves worship the gargantuans as gods.
The division creates friction and fierce battles between prides.
relations.quote: which creates friction and fierce battles between prides

relations.note: Prides follow Marisi's beliefs and celebrate him yearly.
relations.quote: Wild Nacatl prides still celebrate his contribution to the race with a yearly festival.
